title: Ondoway /team step ledger
description: The contract between /team's planning half (writes it) and its execution engine at .claude/team-engine.js (reads it). Extends the shape proven in specs/2026-07-12-new-city-onboarding/state.json: same `steps` key, same free-text `cost`, same tri-state `commit`. Step ids are OPAQUE STRINGS and may be non-integer (that file has an inserted step 6.5) — never treat an id as an array index and never renumber.

topic.description: Slug matching the containing directory, e.g. 'team-refactor'.

tier.description: Set MECHANICALLY from the path-glob table in .claude/commands/team.md — never by judgment. Controls skeptic panel size P = {0:0, 1:0, 2:2, 3:3} and whether acceptance runs.

approved_by_human.description: THE GATE. /team writes false, presents the plan, and ends its turn. It flips to true ONLY after the human says go in chat — the agent transcribes that decision, it never makes it. The execution engine aborts before any fan-out while this is false, which is what stops a different or unattended session running a ledger nobody blessed. The human never edits this by hand.

approved_at.description: ISO-8601, stamped when the human gives their go-ahead in chat. Null until approved.

decisions.description: Free-form record of choices already locked, so no agent relitigates them.

baseline.description: Green-before-work evidence (CLAUDE.md: 'Step 0 baseline must be green').

acceptance_criteria.description: From the product-owner agent. Every criterion must be objectively checkable by a command. A criterion covered by no step is a GAP and blocks approval.

negative.description: True for must-NOT-happen and thin/degraded-input cases.

steps.description: The atomic state machine. Atomic = binary DONE/NOT-DONE, provable by ONE executable command.

id.description: Opaque. Stringified because ids may be non-integer ('6.5').

status.description: Resume table (mirrors .claude/commands/pipeline-batch.md): completed/no-op/skipped -> skip; in_progress -> re-run from Build WITHOUT resetting attempts; blocked -> skip unless retryBlocked; pending -> run.

test_command.description: MUST be a pytest NODE ID inside FILE: make test-file FILE="tests/test_x.py::TestY::test_z". A bare -k is INVALID: Makefile:139-149 has no $(PYTEST_ARGS) passthrough, so make consumes -k as --keep-going and the selector becomes a make goal ('No rule to make target'). FILE is quoted in the recipe, so :: survives. Never LIVE=1 — that routes to test-live, which sets ONDOWAY_ENABLE_PAID_LLM_CALLS=1.

criterion_ids.description: Acceptance criteria this step satisfies. A step citing none is CUT — that is the zero-agent completeness check.

files.description: The only files the developer may touch. Also drives gate_commands.

gate_commands.description: Derived from files by preflight. `make lint` covers ONLY src/ tests/ scripts/{5 files} (Makefile:103-106), so a mobile/ step needs `make flutter-analyze` (which is in neither `lint` nor `test`) and a frontend/ step needs a targeted workbench node id.

depends_on.description: Step ids that must be `completed` first; otherwise this step is skipped.

cost_class.description: Per-step work is always $0. The ONE paid command of a run is the close gate (`make audit`).

cost.description: Free text, for continuity with the existing ledgers ('$0', 'LIVE-estimated').

complexity.description: 'high' starts the developer on opus instead of escalating only on retry.

maxAttempts.description: CLAUDE.md: 'When the same approach fails twice: STOP.' Mechanized.

attempts.description: Persists across resume so a crashed retry does NOT refund budget.

command_valid.description: Set by preflight after grepping the LIVE Makefile. Stale commands are a proven hazard: specs/2026-07-12-new-city-onboarding/state.json cites `make test-local` and `make test-collect` as proof and neither target exists any more.

commit.description: Tri-state for continuity: a sha, "pending", or null. The engine NEVER commits — the human does.

proof.description: One dense house-style line from the judge: bar results, mutation verdict, panel verdicts, ruling.

run.description: Instrumentation appended by the engine after every run. This is the measurement baseline — no prior /team run exists to compare against, so these numbers ARE the before/after ledger the FOUNDING-CASE rule requires.

paid_gate_runs.description: MUST be 0 or 1. Anything higher is a defect in the one-shot guard.
